import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"


def parse_text(el, default=""):
    return el.get_text(strip=True) if el else default


def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

    books = []
    for book in soup.find_all("div", class_="book"):
        title = parse_text(book.find("div", class_="book-title"))
        author_raw = parse_text(book.find("div", class_="book-author"))
        author = re.sub(r"^by\s+", "", author_raw).strip()

        year_raw = parse_text(book.find("span", class_="book-year"))
        rating_raw = parse_text(book.find("span", class_="book-rating"))
        price_raw = parse_text(book.find("span", class_="book-price"))

        m = re.search(r"(\d{4})", year_raw)
        year = int(m.group(1)) if m else None

        m = re.search(r"([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s*/\s*5", rating_raw)
        rating = float(m.group(1)) if m else None

        m = re.search(r"\$?\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)", price_raw)
        price = float(m.group(1)) if m else None

        books.append({
            "title": title,
            "author": author,
            "year": year,
            "rating": rating,
            "price": price,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    top = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    report = (
        "Book Store Scraping Summary Report\n"
        "=================================\n\n"
        f"Total number of books scraped: {total}\n"
        f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}\n"
        f"Highest rated book: {top['title']} by {top['author']} "
        f"(Rating: {top['rating']}/5, Price: ${top['price']:.2f})\n"
    )
    with open("report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(report)

    print(report)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF

import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"


def parse_text(el, default=""):
    return el.get_text(strip=True) if el else default


def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")

    books = []
    for book in soup.find_all("div", class_="book"):
        title = parse_text(book.find("div", class_="book-title"))
        author_raw = parse_text(book.find("div", class_="book-author"))
        author = re.sub(r"^by\s+", "", author_raw).strip()

        year_raw = parse_text(book.find("span", class_="book-year"))
        rating_raw = parse_text(book.find("span", class_="book-rating"))
        price_raw = parse_text(book.find("span", class_="book-price"))

        m = re.search(r"(\d{4})", year_raw)
        year = int(m.group(1)) if m else None

        m = re.search(r"([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s*/\s*5", rating_raw)
        rating = float(m.group(1)) if m else None

        m = re.search(r"\$?\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)", price_raw)
        price = float(m.group(1)) if m else None

        books.append({
            "title": title,
            "author": author,
            "year": year,
            "rating": rating,
            "price": price,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    top = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    report = (
        "Book Store Scraping Summary Report\n"
        "=================================\n\n"
        f"Total number of books scraped: {total}\n"
        f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}\n"
        f"Highest rated book: {top['title']} by {top['author']} "
        f"(Rating: {top['rating']}/5, Price: ${top['price']:.2f})\n"
    )
    with open("report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(report)

    print(report)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
